label: Every earlier state of a possible history is a causal ancestor of its populated later states
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge from temporal precedence to causation, attribution deferred: in every history accessible from the selected world, whenever a contingent concrete individual is present at a moment t, the state at each strictly earlier moment reaches the state at t by a chain of one or more direct state-causation edges. A past of mere succession, whose earlier states are causally idle, rejects it. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter, read under the adopted esse criterion (CONCRETE_6); the Lean type does not enforce that reading.
